The second-biggest prize left on "50th Anniversary" is $1 million, with three of them remaining.

The numbers for "50th Anniversary" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
827.headline: Someone claimed a $15 million prize

847.body:
All the top prizes on "Bingo 50X" have been claimed. That lowers the biggest prize from $500,000 to $100,000. There are two of those left. The prize table has today's count for every prize level.

If you play "Bingo 50X" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
847.headline: Big prize shown, none left

891.body:
